rev.t: Neetu is an exceptional artist who listened to our requirement and produced 4 stunning paintings for our home. …

I have been a student here for 6 months and I  wanted to learn from scratch. I have been impressed from first class the way Neetu taught me. She is so enthusiastic and she is incredibly patient. Her technique of teaching is easy to learn. …

Neetu Art studio is best classes to learn all types of art not only for students buy for all ages. Neetu Mam ja very helpful, detail oriented, compassionate and teaches art with fun. I have learned texture and resin art from Neetu Mam in less than a month. I would recommend this to everyone.
